name: cely-wedding
description: A blank template to get started with Payload 3.0

scripts.build: pnpm run signature && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS="--no-deprecation --max-old-space-size=8000" next build
scripts.dev: pnpm run signature && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--no-deprecation next dev -p 2026
scripts.devsafe: pnpm run signature && rm -rf .next && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--no-deprecation next dev -p 2026
scripts.start: pnpm run signature && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--no-deprecation next start -p 2026
scripts.seed: pnpm run signature && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--no-deprecation tsx src/scripts/seed.ts
scripts.clear: pnpm run signature && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--no-deprecation tsx src/scripts/clear.ts
